basics.name: Nicolas Ha
basics.label: Senior freelance software engineer
basics.summary: Senior freelance software engineer, 12+ years, now building AI systems: small specialized AI models, agentic orchestration and workflows, RAG, MCP tooling, agent memory. References: Griffin Bank, MailOnline. I have led a backend team on a pipeline serving 1.3B views a month, helped stand up new teams inside a bank going for its licence. I have shipped several products from 0 to 1, the latest Klar, an AI spam filter for Apple Mail.

work.name: Klar (klar.im)
work.summary: In production on the App Store: on-device, privacy-preserving spam filter for Apple Mail.
highlights: Trained the classifier in Python: a four-class head on a frozen XLM-RoBERTa encoder, quantised to run on the Mac's own GPU in under 50ms a message, with no network access.
Built the C++17 engine it runs on (llama.cpp/GGML) behind a stable C API, with Node and Swift bindings, a Postfix milter and Docker end-to-end tests.
AI tooling: custom memory and retrieval (MCP, LangChain, RAG, agent hooks and skills).

work.name: Narval (GM NFT)
work.summary: Joined a company of 4 as an early engineer, before any product existed.
highlights: Built custodian integrations (BitGo, Zodia) enabling institutional custodians to access DeFi (Aave staking, TON transactions), with GNAP/OAuth authn/authz on an OPA policy engine.
Built transaction decoding/proxy infrastructure for on-chain transaction validation (EIP-7730).

work.name: Griffin Bank (BaaS)
work.summary: Built platform components a UK banking licence depended on, in a heavily regulated environment.
highlights: Led several new platform initiatives end-to-end, and helped build out new engineering teams as the org scaled toward its licence.
Implemented secure admin authorization, a webhooks architecture, and passkey-based multi-factor authentication.
Designed the queuing and processing systems, audit logging, scheduled-job infrastructure, and HTTP message signing behind it.

work.name: TurtleQueue (SaaS)
work.summary: Led development of TurtleQueue, a message broker SaaS platform compatible with Apache Pulsar and Apache Kafka.
highlights: Took the product 0-to-1: designed and built the entire technology stack from scratch; secured R&D tax incentives.
Built a proxy speaking the Apache Kafka and Apache Pulsar wire protocols, so existing client applications connected without changes.
Hired and led a small team of contractor engineers to scale delivery.
Ran freelance contract engineering for MailOnline in parallel.

work.name: MailOnline (Media)
work.summary: Promoted from Senior Engineer to Backend Team Lead, managing a team of experienced developers.
highlights: Architected and scaled the core publishing pipeline to 1.3B views a month.
Implemented ad placement that increased revenue; delivered real-time analytics that reduced feedback cycles.

work.name: Go Find It (Startup mobile apps)
work.summary: Built a full-stack mobile CMS for luxury hotels.
highlights: Ran the pipeline from development through DevOps to App Store publishing for a team of 10 mobile developers, with Python SSH deployment tooling.

work.name: Apizee (Startup web telecommunications)
highlights: Took a prototype 0-to-1: connectors bridging WebRTC customers with legacy phone systems (Alcatel-Lucent SIP IMS, RCS), and the measurement tooling for Orange Labs that won a multi-year contract with Orange.
Technology demoed at Mobile World Congress Barcelona, on HP's booth.

work.name: Siléane (Robotics SMB)
highlights: Prototyped 0-to-1 a controller for a Fanuc industrial robotic arm driven by Microsoft Kinect vision, so non-technical users could program movement paths by gesture.

work.name: Dassault Aviation (equipments division)
highlights: Developed an automated debugging bench to stress-test military avionics flight-control circuit boards, enabling 24-hour testing cycles that cut testing time by 50%.

education.summary: Student representative. Erasmus exchange in Germany, with classes taught in German.

education.summary: Coursework included C, embedded/real-time systems design, and state machines.
